verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl lə·’ā·sāp̄ ha·’ă·zî·nāh ‘am·mî tō·w·rā·ṯî haṭ·ṭū ’ā·zə·nə·ḵem lə·’im·rê- p̄î
verses.literal: A Maskil of Asaph Give ear O my people to my instruction listen . . . to the words of my mouth

verses.original: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה פִּ֑י בְמָשָׁ֣ל אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי־ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·tə·ḥāh pî ḇə·mā·šāl ’ab·bî·‘āh ḥî·ḏō·wṯ min·nî- qe·ḏem
verses.literal: I will open my mouth in parables I will utter things hidden from the beginning

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer šā·maʿ·nû wan·nê·ḏā·‘êm wa·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū sip·pə·rū- lā·nū
verses.literal: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us

verses.original: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד׀ מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים אַחֲר֗וֹן לְד֥וֹר תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: lō nə·ḵa·ḥêḏ mib·bə·nê·hem mə·sap·pə·rîm ’a·ḥă·rō·wn lə·ḏō·wr tə·hil·lō·wṯ Yah·weh we·‘ĕ·zū·zōw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: We will not hide [them] from their children but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might and the wonders - He has performed

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת׀ בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב שָׂ֤ם וְתוֹרָה֮ בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem ‘ê·ḏūṯ bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ śām wə·ṯō·w·rāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū lə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ām liḇ·nê·hem
verses.literal: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel which He commanded - our fathers to teach to their children

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן אַ֭חֲרוֹן דּ֣וֹר יֵדְע֨וּ׀ בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ’a·ḥă·rō·wn dō·wr yê·ḏə·‘ū bā·nîm yiw·wā·lê·ḏū yā·qu·mū wî·sap·pə·rū liḇ·nê·hem
verses.literal: that the coming generation would know them even children yet to be born to arise and tell their [own] children

verses.original: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ אֵ֑ל מַֽעַלְלֵי־ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃ וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·śî·mū kis·lām ḇê·lō·hîm wə·lō yiš·kə·ḥū ’êl ma·‘al·lê- yin·ṣō·rū ū·miṣ·wō·ṯāw
verses.literal: that they should put their confidence in God not forgetting [His] works but keeping His commandments

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ׀ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּוֹר֮ דּ֭וֹר לִבּ֑וֹ לֹא־ הֵכִ֣ין רוּחֽוֹ׃ וְלֹא־ נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת־ אֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yih·yū ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām sō·w·rêr ū·mō·reh dō·wr dō·wr lib·bōw lō- hê·ḵîn rū·ḥōw wə·lō- ne·’em·nāh ’eṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: Then they will not be like their fathers a stubborn and rebellious generation - whose heart was not loyal whose spirit was not faithful to God

verses.original: נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי־ קָ֑שֶׁת בְּֽנֵי־ אֶפְרַ֗יִם הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: nō·wō·šə·qê rō·w·mê- qā·šeṯ bə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim hā·p̄ə·ḵū bə·yō·wm qə·rāḇ
verses.literal: The archers . . . . . . vvv of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle

verses.original: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּרִ֣ית מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃ וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: lō šā·mə·rû ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·rîṯ mê·’ă·nū lā·le·ḵeṯ ū·ḇə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kə·ḥū ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯāw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw ’ă·šer her·’ām
verses.literal: They forgot what He had done the wonders - He had shown them

verses.original: עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה־ צֹֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śāh p̄e·le ne·ḡeḏ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim śə·ḏêh- ṣō·‘an
verses.literal: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt in the region of Zoan

verses.original: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב־ מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ־ נֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bā·qa‘ yām way·ya·‘ă·ḇî·rêm way·yaṣ·ṣeḇ- ma·yim kə·mōw- nêḏ
verses.literal: He split the sea and brought them through He set the waters {upright} like a wall

verses.original: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם בְּא֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ׃ וְכָל־ הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה
verses.transliteration: way·yan·ḥêm be·‘ā·nān yō·w·mām bə·’ō·wr ’êš wə·ḵāl hal·lay·lāh
verses.literal: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night

verses.original: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ רַבָּֽה׃ כִּתְהֹמ֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: yə·ḇaq·qa‘ ṣu·rîm bam·miḏ·bār way·yašq rab·bāh kiṯ·hō·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave [them] drink as abundant as the seas

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע מָֽיִם׃ וַיּ֖וֹרֶד כַּנְּהָר֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi nō·wz·lîm mis·sā·la‘ mā·yim way·yō·w·reḏ kan·nə·hā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers

verses.original: וַיּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַחֲטֹא־ ל֑וֹ לַֽמְר֥וֹת בַּצִּיָּֽה׃ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·sî·p̄ū ‘ō·wḏ la·ḥă·ṭō- lōw lam·rō·wṯ baṣ·ṣî·yāh ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: But they continued . . . to sin against Him rebelling in the desert against the Most High

verses.original: בִּלְבָבָ֑ם וַיְנַסּוּ־ אֵ֥ל לִֽשְׁאָל־ אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: bil·ḇā·ḇām way·nas·sū- ’êl liš·’āl- ’ō·ḵel lə·nap̄·šām
verses.literal: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved

verses.original: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bə·rū bê·lō·hîm ’ā·mə·rū hă·yū·ḵal ’êl la·‘ă·rōḵ šul·ḥān bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: They spoke against God saying Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה־ צ֨וּר׀ מַיִם֮ וַיָּז֣וּבוּ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ י֣וּכַל הֲגַם־ תֵּ֑ת לֶ֭חֶם אִם־ יָכִ֖ין לְעַמּֽוֹ׃ שְׁאֵ֣ר
verses.transliteration: hên hik·kāh- ṣūr ma·yim way·yā·zū·ḇū ū·nə·ḥā·lîm yiš·ṭō·p̄ū yū·ḵal hă·ḡam- têṯ le·ḥem ’im- yā·ḵîn lə·‘am·mōw šə·’êr
verses.literal: When He struck the rock water gushed out and torrents raged But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן׀ יְהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥ע וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם־ אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên Yah·weh šā·ma‘ way·yiṯ·‘ab·bār wə·’êš niś·śə·qāh ḇə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ḡam- ’ap̄ ‘ā·lāh ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath so a fire was kindled against Jacob and His anger flared against Israel

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō he·’ĕ·mî·nū bê·lō·hîm wə·lō ḇā·ṭə·ḥū bî·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: because they did not believe God . . . or rely on His salvation

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל פָּתָֽח׃ וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw šə·ḥā·qîm mim·mā·‘al pā·ṯāḥ wə·ḏal·ṯê šā·ma·yim
verses.literal: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens

verses.original: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר מָ֣ן עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם לֶאֱכֹ֑ל נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃ וּדְגַן־ שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם
verses.transliteration: way·yam·ṭêr mān ‘ă·lê·hem le·’ĕ·ḵōl nā·ṯan lā·mōw ū·ḏə·ḡa·nō·šā- šā·ma·yim
verses.literal: He rained down manna for them to eat He gave them grain from heaven

verses.original: אִ֑ישׁ אָ֣כַל לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם צֵידָ֬ה לָשֹֽׂבַע׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’ā·ḵal le·ḥem ’ab·bî·rîm šā·laḥ lā·hem ṣê·ḏāh lā·śō·ḇa‘
verses.literal: Man ate the bread of angels He sent them food in abundance

verses.original: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג תֵימָֽן׃ בְּעֻזּ֣וֹ
verses.transliteration: yas·sa‘ qā·ḏîm baš·šā·mā·yim way·na·hêḡ ṯê·mān bə·‘uz·zōw
verses.literal: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might

verses.original: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר שְׁאֵ֑ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּנָֽף׃ ע֣וֹף וּֽכְח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים
verses.transliteration: way·yam·ṭêr šə·’êr ‘ă·lê·hem ke·‘ā·p̄ār kā·nāp̄ ‘ō·wp̄ ū·ḵə·ḥō·wl yam·mîm
verses.literal: He rained meat on them like dust and winged birds like the sand of the sea

verses.original: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yap·pêl bə·qe·reḇ ma·ḥă·nê·hū sā·ḇîḇ lə·miš·kə·nō·ṯāw
verses.literal: He felled them in the midst of their camp all around their dwellings

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם׃ וְ֝תַֽאֲוָתָ֗ם
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḵə·lū mə·’ōḏ way·yiś·bə·‘ū yā·ḇi lā·hem wə·ṯa·’ă·wā·ṯām
verses.literal: So they ate and were well filled for He gave them what they craved

verses.original: לֹא־ זָר֥וּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם אָכְלָ֥ם ע֝֗וֹד בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- zā·rū mit·ta·’ă·wā·ṯām ’ā·ḵə·lām ‘ō·wḏ bə·p̄î·hem
verses.literal: Yet before they had filled their desire with the food still in their mouths

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ וְאַ֤ף עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם הִכְרִֽיעַ׃ וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’ap̄ ‘ā·lāh ḇā·hem way·ya·hă·rōḡ bə·miš·man·nê·hem hiḵ·rî·a‘ ū·ḇa·ḥū·rê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: God’s anger flared against them and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel

verses.original: בְּכָל־ זֹ֭את חָֽטְאוּ־ ע֑וֹד בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃ וְלֹֽא־ הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵāl zōṯ ḥā·ṭə·’ū- ‘ō·wḏ bə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw wə·lō- he·’ĕ·mî·nū
verses.literal: In spite of all this they kept on sinning despite His wonderful works they did not believe

verses.original: וַיְכַל־ יְמֵיהֶ֑ם בַּהֶ֥בֶל וּ֝שְׁנוֹתָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal- yə·mê·hem ba·he·ḇel ū·šə·nō·w·ṯām bab·be·hā·lāh
verses.literal: So He ended their days in futility and their years in sudden terror

verses.original: אִם־ הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- hă·rā·ḡām ū·ḏə·rā·šū·hū wə·šā·ḇū wə·ši·ḥă·rū- ’êl
verses.literal: When He slew them they would seek Him they repented and searched for God

verses.original: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kə·rū kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣū·rām wə·’êl ‘el·yō·wn gō·’ă·lām
verses.literal: And they remembered that God was their Rock that God Most High was their Redeemer

verses.original: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם יְכַזְּבוּ־ לֽוֹ׃ וּ֝בִלְשׁוֹנָ֗ם
verses.transliteration: way·p̄at·tū·hū bə·p̄î·hem yə·ḵaz·zə·ḇū- lōw ū·ḇil·šō·w·nām
verses.literal: But they deceived Him with their mouths and lied to Him with their tongues

verses.original: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא־ נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lib·bām lō- nā·ḵō·wn ‘im·mōw wə·lō ne·’em·nū biḇ·rî·ṯōw
verses.literal: Their hearts were disloyal . . . to Him and they were unfaithful . . . to His covenant

verses.original: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־ יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה אַפּ֑וֹ לְהָשִׁ֣יב וְלֹֽא־ יָ֝עִיר כָּל־ חֲמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ra·ḥūm yə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·wōn wə·lō- yaš·ḥîṯ wə·hir·bāh ’ap·pōw lə·hā·šîḇ wə·lō- yā·‘îr kāl- ḥă·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: And yet He was compassionate He forgave [their] iniquity and did not destroy them He often restrained His anger . . . and did not unleash vvv His full wrath

verses.original: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּי־ הֵ֑מָּה בָשָׂ֣ר ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ ר֥וּחַ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kōr kî- hêm·māh ḇā·śār hō·w·lêḵ rū·aḥ wə·lō yā·šūḇ
verses.literal: He remembered that they were but flesh a passing breeze that does not return

verses.original: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kam·māh yam·rū·hū ḇam·miḏ·bār ya·‘ă·ṣî·ḇū·hū bî·šî·mō·wn
verses.literal: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert

verses.original: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל הִתְווּ׃ וּקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šū·ḇū way·nas·sū ’êl hiṯ·wū ū·qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: לֹא־ זָכְר֥וּ אֶת־ יָד֑וֹ י֝֗וֹם אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ פָּדָ֥ם מִנִּי־ צָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- zā·ḵə·rū ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw yō·wm ’ăšer- pā·ḏām min·nî- ṣār
verses.literal: They did not remember - His power the day - He redeemed them from the adversary

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣ם אֹֽתוֹתָ֑יו בְּ֭מִצְרַיִם וּ֝מוֹפְתָ֗יו בִּשְׂדֵה־ צֹֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- śām ’ō·ṯō·w·ṯāw bə·miṣ·ra·yim ū·mō·wp̄·ṯāw biś·ḏêh- ṣō·‘an
verses.literal: when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan

verses.original: וַיַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ יְאֹרֵיהֶ֑ם לְ֭דָם וְ֝נֹזְלֵיהֶ֗ם בַּל־ יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·p̄ōḵ yə·’ō·rê·hem lə·ḏām wə·nō·zə·lê·hem bal- yiš·tā·yūn
verses.literal: He turned their rivers to blood and from their streams they could not drink

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּהֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וּ֝צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·laḥ bā·hem ‘ā·rōḇ way·yō·ḵə·lêm ū·ṣə·p̄ar·dê·a‘ wat·taš·ḥî·ṯêm
verses.literal: He sent - swarms of flies that devoured them and frogs that devastated them

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יְבוּלָ֑ם לֶחָסִ֣יל וִֽ֝יגִיעָ֗ם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên yə·ḇū·lām le·ḥā·sîl wî·ḡî·‘ām lā·’ar·beh
verses.literal: He gave their crops to the grasshopper the fruit of their labor to the locust

verses.original: יַהֲרֹ֣ג גַּפְנָ֑ם בַּבָּרָ֣ד וְ֝שִׁקְמוֹתָ֗ם בַּֽחֲנָמַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ya·hă·rōḡ gap̄·nām bab·bā·rāḏ wə·šiq·mō·w·ṯām ba·ḥă·nā·mal
verses.literal: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet

verses.original: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר בְּעִירָ֑ם לַבָּרָ֣ד וּ֝מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·gêr bə·‘î·rām lab·bā·rāḏ ū·miq·nê·hem lā·rə·šā·p̄îm
verses.literal: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּח־ חֲר֬וֹן אַפּ֗וֹ בָּ֨ם׀ עֶבְרָ֣ה וָזַ֣עַם וְצָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת רָעִֽים׃ מַלְאֲכֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·laḥ- ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw bām ‘eḇ·rāh wā·za·‘am wə·ṣā·rāh miš·la·ḥaṯ rā·‘îm mal·’ă·ḵê
verses.literal: He unleashed His fury . . . against them wrath indignation and calamity a band of destroying angels

verses.original: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְאַ֫פּ֥וֹ לֹא־ חָשַׂ֣ךְ נַפְשָׁ֑ם מִמָּ֣וֶת הִסְגִּֽיר׃ וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם לַדֶּ֥בֶר
verses.transliteration: yə·p̄al·lês nā·ṯîḇ lə·’ap·pōw lō- ḥā·śaḵ nap̄·šām mim·mā·weṯ his·gîr wə·ḥay·yā·ṯām lad·de·ḇer
verses.literal: He cleared a path for His anger He did not spare them from death but delivered their lives to the plague

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־ בְּכ֣וֹר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית א֝וֹנִ֗ים בְּאָהֳלֵי־ חָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·miṣ·rā·yim rê·šîṯ ’ō·w·nîm bə·’ā·ho·lê- ḥām
verses.literal: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt vvv the virility in the tents of Ham

verses.original: עַמּ֑וֹ וַיַּסַּ֣ע כַּצֹּ֣אן וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֥ם כַּ֝עֵ֗דֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mōw way·yas·sa‘ kaṣ·ṣōn way·na·hă·ḡêm ka·‘ê·ḏer bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: He led out His people . . . like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness

verses.original: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם לָ֭בֶטַח וְלֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְאֶת־ הַיָּֽם׃ כִּסָּ֥ה א֝וֹיְבֵיהֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: way·yan·ḥêm lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·lō p̄ā·ḥā·ḏū wə·’eṯ- hay·yām kis·sāh ’ō·wy·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: He led them safely so they did not fear but the sea engulfed their enemies

verses.original: וַ֭יְבִיאֵם אֶל־ קָדְשׁ֑וֹ גְּב֣וּל הַר־ זֶ֝֗ה יְמִינֽוֹ׃ קָנְתָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: way·ḇî·’êm ’el- qā·ḏə·šōw gə·ḇūl har- zeh yə·mî·nōw qā·nə·ṯāh
verses.literal: He brought them to His holy land to the mountain . . . His right hand had acquired

verses.original: וַיְגָ֤רֶשׁ גּוֹיִ֗ם מִפְּנֵיהֶ֨ם׀ וַֽ֭יַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: way·ḡā·reš gō·w·yim mip·pə·nê·hem way·yap·pî·lêm bə·ḥe·ḇel na·ḥă·lāh way·yaš·kên šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl bə·’ā·ho·lê·hem
verses.literal: He drove out nations before them and apportioned . . . their inheritance He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents

verses.original: וַיְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭יַּמְרוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃ וְ֝עֵדוֹתָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: way·nas·sū way·yam·rū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘el·yō·wn lō šā·mā·rū wə·‘ê·ḏō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: But they tested and disobeyed - God Most High for they did not keep His decrees

verses.original: וַיִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֑ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sō·ḡū way·yiḇ·gə·ḏū ka·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām neh·pə·ḵū rə·mî·yāh kə·qe·šeṯ
verses.literal: They turned back and were faithless like their fathers twisted like a faulty bow

verses.original: וַיַּכְעִיס֥וּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָ֑ם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃ וּ֝בִפְסִילֵיהֶ֗ם
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·‘î·sū·hū bə·ḇā·mō·w·ṯām yaq·nî·’ū·hū ū·ḇip̄·sî·lê·hem
verses.literal: They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַיִּמְאַ֥ס בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ מְ֝אֹ֗ד
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiṯ·‘ab·bār way·yim·’as bə·yiś·rā·’êl mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: On hearing it God was furious and rejected Israel completely

verses.transliteration: way·yiṭ·ṭōš miš·kan ši·lōw ’ō·hel šik·kên bā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh the tent He had pitched among men

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן עֻזּ֑וֹ לַשְּׁבִ֣י וְֽתִפְאַרְתּ֥וֹ בְיַד־ צָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ‘uz·zōw laš·šə·ḇî wə·ṯip̄·’ar·tōw ḇə·yaḏ- ṣār
verses.literal: He delivered His strength to captivity and His splendor to the hand of the adversary

verses.original: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר עַמּ֑וֹ לַחֶ֣רֶב הִתְעַבָּֽר׃ וּ֝בְנַחֲלָת֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·yas·gêr ‘am·mōw la·ḥe·reḇ hiṯ·‘ab·bār ū·ḇə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage

verses.original: אֵ֑שׁ אָֽכְלָה־ בַּחוּרָ֥יו וּ֝בְתוּלֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh- ba·ḥū·rāw ū·ḇə·ṯū·lō·ṯāw lō hūl·lā·lū
verses.literal: Fire consumed His young men and their maidens were left without wedding songs

verses.original: כֹּ֭הֲנָיו נָפָ֑לוּ בַּחֶ֣רֶב וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: kō·hă·nāw nā·p̄ā·lū ba·ḥe·reḇ wə·’al·mə·nō·ṯāw lō ṯiḇ·ke·nāh
verses.literal: His priests fell by the sword but their widows could not lament

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֑י וַיִּקַ֖ץ כְּיָשֵׁ֥ן׀ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר מִתְרוֹנֵ֥ן מִיָּֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy way·yi·qaṣ kə·yā·šên kə·ḡib·bō·wr miṯ·rō·w·nên mî·yā·yin
verses.literal: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep like a mighty warrior overcome by wine

verses.original: וַיַּךְ־ אָח֑וֹר צָרָ֥יו נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃ ע֝וֹלָ֗ם חֶרְפַּ֥ת
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ- ’ā·ḥō·wr ṣā·rāw nā·ṯan lā·mōw ‘ō·w·lām ḥer·paṯ
verses.literal: He beat back His foes He put them to . . . everlasting shame

verses.original: וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף לֹ֣א בָחָֽר׃ וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם
verses.transliteration: way·yim·’as bə·’ō·hel yō·w·sêp̄ lō ḇā·ḥār ū·ḇə·šê·ḇeṭ ’ep̄·ra·yim
verses.literal: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused . . . the tribe of Ephraim

verses.original: וַ֭יִּבְחַר אֶת־ שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת־ הַ֥ר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·ḥar ’eṯ- šê·ḇeṭ yə·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ- har ṣî·yō·wn ’ă·šer ’ā·hêḇ
verses.literal: But He chose - the tribe of Judah - Mount Zion which He loved

verses.original: וַיִּ֣בֶן מִקְדָּשׁ֑וֹ כְּמוֹ־ רָ֭מִים כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen miq·dā·šōw kə·mōw- rā·mîm kə·’e·reṣ yə·sā·ḏāh lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He built His sanctuary like the heights like the earth He has established forever

verses.original: וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·ḥar bə·ḏā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dōw way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū mim·miḵ·lə·’ōṯ ṣōn
verses.literal: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds . . .

verses.original: מֵאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱ֫בִיא֥וֹ לִ֭רְעוֹת עַמּ֑וֹ בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’a·ḥar ‘ā·lō·wṯ hĕ·ḇî·’ōw lir·‘ō·wṯ ‘am·mōw bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ḇə·yiś·rā·’êl na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob of Israel His inheritance

verses.original: וַ֭יִּרְעֵם כְּתֹ֣ם לְבָב֑וֹ יַנְחֵֽם׃ וּבִתְבוּנ֖וֹת כַּפָּ֣יו
verses.transliteration: way·yir·‘êm kə·ṯōm lə·ḇā·ḇōw yan·ḥêm ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nō·wṯ kap·pāw
verses.literal: So [David] shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands
